title: Skip-Pass Catch-and-Shoot
description: Shooters catch long skip passes across the court with the feet already set, turning the time the ball is in the air into preparation for the shot.

content.objective: Use the flight time of a skip pass to set the feet and catch in rhythm for a shot.
content.setup: Passer at the left wing; shooter at the right wing or corner.
content.organization: Shooter rebounds and becomes the passer on the other side.
instructions: The passer throws an overhead skip across the floor.
As the ball travels, the shooter steps into the catch and loads the legs.
Catch in the pocket and shoot without dipping.
coachingPoints: Prepare while the ball is in the air.
Catch high, shoot high: no dip.
Feet face the rim before the ball arrives.
commonMistakes: Waiting until the ball arrives to move the feet.
Stepping out of range to meet the pass.
content.safety: Shooters rebound their own ball only when the lane is clear; nobody stands under the rim while others shoot.
progressions: Add a defender recovering from the help.
variations: Skip to the corner from the top.
content.gameApplication: Skip passes beat help defenders; the shooter must be ready when they land.
